# Community Rule Column 3 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 3

---

**3:1** No one who stubbornly follows his own heart can be counted among the righteous, because he mistakes darkness for the path of light. Among the truly faithful
**3:2** he will never be included. No sacrificial offering can purify him, no ritual washing can make him clean,
**3:3** no immersion in seas or rivers can sanctify him — no water of any kind can wash him pure. He remains utterly defiled
**3:4** for as long as he refuses to accept God's decrees, rejecting the discipline found within God's purposeful community.
**3:5** For it is through the spirit of God's true purpose that a person's way of life is set right — all
**3:6** of their wrongdoing — enabling them to behold the light of life. Through the holy spirit active in the community, grounded in His truth,
**3:7** they are purified from every wrong. Through a spirit of honesty and humility their sin is made right;
**3:8** and through the willing submission of their whole self to all of God's commands, their very being is made clean,
**3:9** ready to be washed with purifying waters and made holy by cleansing streams. They must then set their course
**3:10** to walk with complete devotion in all of God's ways, following what He has decreed for each appointed season,
**3:11** never veering to the right or the left, never violating
**3:12** a single one of His instructions. Then they will be welcomed through gracious atonement in God's presence, and this will become for them a covenant with
**3:13** the eternal community.
**3:14** This is for the Instructor, so that he may guide and teach all the Children of Light about the true character
**3:15** of every human being — the full range of spiritual dispositions with their identifying traits, their patterns of behavior
**3:16** across the generations, and the consequences they face: both their sufferings and the seasons of their blessing.
**3:17** Everything that exists or ever will exist comes from the God of all knowledge. Before anything came to be, He designed it all.
**3:18** When things come into being at their designated times, they carry out their purpose exactly as He magnificently planned,
**3:19** and nothing can be altered. He holds the governing principles of all things and provides for every need.
**3:20** He created humanity to govern the world, and He assigned to each person two spirits
**3:21** to guide them until the time when He intervenes decisively: these are the spirits of
**3:22** truth and deception. From a fountain of light flows the origin of truth, and from a wellspring of
**3:23** darkness rises the origin of falsehood. The Prince of Light holds authority over all
**3:24** who live righteously — they walk in the ways of light. The Angel of
**3:25** Darkness holds authority over all who practice deceit — they walk in the ways of darkness.
**3:26** Because of the Angel of Darkness, even the righteous go astray; all their failings, sins, guilt, and offenses happen under his influence,

---
*PNEUMA notes: Column 3 is theologically dense, containing the opening of the Two Spirits treatise (3:13-26), one of the most important theological passages in the Dead Sea Scrolls. The translation aims to make the dualistic worldview accessible to modern readers while preserving its force. "Maskil" rendered "Instructor" with all three agents agreeing on this term. "Prince of Light" and "Angel of Darkness" are cosmic figures governing two halves of humanity. The deterministic theology (3:17-19) — that God foreordained everything — is rendered clearly. The purification theology (3:1-12) emphasizes that external ritual alone cannot cleanse without inner submission to God's community.*
